Which states reported the most toxic chemicals released into the air in 2022?

SELECT _8_st AS state, round(sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which particles turn up most often among decay products in the Particle Data Group tables?
SELECT name AS particle, count(*) AS appearances FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgdecay WHERE is_outgoing = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
